findings.issue: the C1570 positive control specified the result type both ways, so it was itself nonconforming
findings.resolution: control FUNCTION f() RESULT(r) with INTEGER :: r; the rejected program adds only INTEGER :: f

findings.issue: an explicitly initialised local was used as an unsaved local, but initialisation implies SAVE (8.4 p3)
findings.resolution: a genuinely unsaved local k in a recursive s(n,out) gives out == [1,2,3] (a shared local would give [1,1,1]), with a SAVE-counter companion
